==Flavor Text==

''His carapace sheathed his wings more efficiently than the finest of armors.''

==About==

A {{i|Beetle}} can be found most commonly by {{i|Lift}}ing any {{i|Boulder}} that has sat long enough on the surface and looking underneath. Additionally a Beetle can be found by chance inside {{i|Hollow Log}}s and {{i|Hollow Stump}}s, Dissecting a {{i|Frog}}, Releasing a {{i|Bug in a Blanket}}, or grown by placing a {{i|Grub}} is placed in any [[Container]] for a few days.
